hypothesis: The C2_B word (1,2) representation may spend capacity on rare pair co-occurrences that do not transfer across future cycles; unigram-only or unigram binary-presence TF-IDF may be more stable.
metric: Macro F1 using fixed labels [0,1] and threshold 0.50
fit_boundary: Official Classification Train only. At cutoffs 55 and 67, fit every row with 47 <= cycle_code <= cutoff, including blank/missing streams. No validation labels enter fitting or selection.
source_boundary: Official Train is the only dataset opened. Official Test and SampleSubmission are not read.

base.structured: Reuse ClassificationModel C2_B expanded structured preprocessing, fit-only scaling, fit-only one-hot encoding, sparse design, and missing-stream indicator.
base.logistic_regression: Unchanged C2_B LogisticRegression parameters: C=1.0, solver=liblinear, max_iter=2000, tol=0.0001, class_weight=null, random_state=42.
base.fit_population: All past official Train rows, including blank/missing signal_stream rows.
base.only_change: Present expert word TF-IDF vectorizer configuration; no structured preprocessing or logistic-regression change.

controls.current_champion: Exact archived C2_B predictions on present rows plus exact archived CB_MISSING predictions on blank/missing rows.
controls.c2b_fit_scope: All official Train rows through each cutoff.
controls.cb_missing_fit_scope: All official Train rows through each cutoff; stream availability selects its prediction branch only.

continuation_gate.improvement: At least one pooled view (W1+W4 primary or H12_E+H12_L) has Macro F1 strictly above the exact current champion route.
continuation_gate.guardrail: For each individual W1, W4, H12_E, and H12_L view, candidate Macro F1 is no more than 0.005 below the exact current champion route.
continuation_gate.stop: Regardless of gate outcome, stop after pilot and independent verification for Main review.

known_champion_reference.interpretation: Historical six-window values are context only; the pilot gate compares candidate and incumbent on identical pilot rows.
